site.name: Science Buzz
site.tagline: One amazing science fact every day.

facts.title: A day on Venus is longer than its year
facts.headline: Venus spins incredibly slowly.
facts.description: Venus takes about 243 Earth days to rotate once on its axis, while it takes about 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun.

facts.title: Plants can warn their neighbors
facts.headline: Some plants communicate through chemical signals.
facts.description: When attacked, plants can release airborne chemicals that influence nearby plants and can help them prepare defensive responses.

facts.title: Light can behave like a wave and a particle
facts.headline: Light has a remarkable dual nature.
facts.description: Experiments show that light displays both wave-like and particle-like behavior, a key idea in quantum physics.
